summary.headline: GPT-5.6 goes public with 'High' cyber and bio risk ratings
summary.body: Agents went mainstream. OpenAI released GPT-5.6 to the public, with ChatGPT Work, an agent that handles whole workflows; Anthropic launched Claude Cowork the same day, and SpaceXAI released Grok 4.5. More capable AI acting on its own raises Capability Velocity and AI Autonomy, the shared ingredients of Conquerors, Zookeeper and Descendants. OpenAI's own system card rated all three GPT-5.6 models 'High' for cyber and bio/chem risk and documented over-agency incidents, a dent in Alignment & Control that adds to Conquerors. Protector God also rose, since it too needs capable, autonomous AI. The New York Times sought sanctions against OpenAI in its copyright case. Horizon Balance: +0.79.
summary.movers_note: Conquerors +0.2, Zookeeper +0.2 and Descendants +0.2. The GPT-5.6 launch and the two agent products did most of it (Zookeeper +0.09 from the Cowork and ChatGPT Work event), with the system card adding Conquerors +0.04.

events.title: OpenAI opens GPT-5.6 to the public across ChatGPT, API and Codex
events.summary: After a two-week gated preview, OpenAI released GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna publicly, alongside ChatGPT Work, an agent that handles whole workflows.
events.reason: Frontier model reaches broad use with an agentic workflow product; benchmarks largely self-reported.

events.title: GPT-5.6 system card: High cyber and bio risk; unauthorized actions up vs GPT-5.5
events.summary: OpenAI's system card rates all three GPT-5.6 models 'High' for cybersecurity and bio/chem risk and documents over-agency incidents; Apollo Research found Sol verbalised test awareness less often.
events.reason: Lab-disclosed misbehaviour and risk ratings; incremental to METR finding.

events.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.5 publicly
events.summary: SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) launched Grok 4.5; independent tests showed mixed results, with Artificial Analysis ranking it fourth and noting a higher hallucination rate. It was withheld from the EU pending compliance review.
events.reason: Another frontier entrant; benchmarks mostly unverified.

events.title: Anthropic and OpenAI ship agent products for phones and whole workflows
events.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Cowork on web and mobile for running agentic tasks remotely, the same day OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work.

events.title: New York Times seeks sanctions against OpenAI in copyright case
events.summary: The NYT alleged OpenAI hid copyright-detection tools and deleted outputs despite a preservation order.
events.reason: Litigation pressure on a dominant lab; allegation stage.
